contracts: (IdentityBoundaryTests credential-kind case passes with explicit three-use mapping and denial of other uses.) AND (IdentityBoundaryTests discovery is nonzero and OIDC-first/credential-kind assertions pass without provider deployment.) AND (IdentityBoundaryTests provider-scope assertion passes without external provider startup or deployment.) AND (IdentityBoundaryTests scope guard runs with nonzero assertions and no password dependency.)
selector_intents: IdentityCompatibility_UsesDeclaredCredentialKinds fails when administrator bearer credentials map to human production authentication or any use outside bootstrap, migration, and controlled service.
IdentityCompatibility_UsesDeclaredCredentialKinds rejects non-OIDC-first human identity directions and any external-provider deployment assumption.
Provider-scope selector fails when implementation introduces, requires, or claims an external identity-provider deployment.
SM-I03 scope guard fails if password-authentication implementation or dependency is introduced.
